away.title: Away from home
away.error: Nocturne couldn’t open this. What you kept is safe.

away.simple.hint: Cloudflare offers this for free without promises, so it may sometimes stop working.

away.off.ask.title: Ask
away.off.ask.body: “What does Leo need for his trip?” at the school gate, with where the answer came from.
away.off.keep.title: Keep

away.off.page.title: Read today’s page
away.off.page.body: On the train, before you get to your computer.
away.off.status: It’s off. Nothing is downloaded, started or connected until you set it up.
away.off.statusBefore: It’s off. Nothing is running or connected.
away.off.stayPaired: {count, plural, one {Your phone stays paired and will work again when you turn this on.} other {Your # phones stay paired and will work again when you turn this on.}}

away.cant.heading: Your phone can’t
away.cant.here: Do those here, on this computer.
away.cant.all: Your phone can’t delete, forget, export or change settings. Do that here.
away.can.heading: Your phone can
away.can.ask: Ask, with where each answer came from
away.can.keep: Keep a note, a photo or a voice note
away.can.read: Read today’s page and the last week’s
away.private.note: Things you marked private stay on this computer.
away.private.label: Private things on your phones
away.starting: Nocturne is starting the connection. This takes a few seconds.
away.starting.title: Starting the connection through {company}.
away.on.lead: While this is on, your phone can reach this computer over the internet. Nothing goes anywhere else.
away.on.machine: Shows as {name} in your Tailscale account.
away.autoOff.label: Turn off by itself
away.autoOff.hint: So it’s only on when you need it
away.autoOff.unused: When no phone has used it for 30 days
away.awake.label: Keep this computer awake while it’s on
away.awake.hint: So your phones can always reach it. Only while plugged in. Uses more power.
away.removeAll: Turn off and remove all phones…
away.removeAll.title: Turn off and remove all phones?
away.removeAll.body: Away from home turns off and every phone is removed. Each one stops working at once.
away.removeAll.kept: What your phones kept is already here and stays. Nothing on this computer is deleted.
away.phones.heading: Phones · {count}
away.phones.lost: Lost a phone? Remove it here and it stops working at once.
away.sent.label: Sent to your phones
away.sent.counted: Counted here, as it leaves this computer.
away.relink.qr: Code with the new address, to scan with each phone
away.relink.title: Your computer has a new address. Scan this code with each phone to reconnect.
away.relink.how: On each phone, open Nocturne and choose Scan the code, then point it at your computer. Your phones are still paired, so there’s nothing to allow.
away.relink.cantScan: Can’t scan? In Nocturne on the phone, type these four words:
away.relink.list: Phones and whether they have the new address
away.relink.allDone: Every phone has the new address.
away.relink.waiting: {count, plural, one {{name} is waiting for the new address.} other {# phones are waiting for the new address.}}
away.relink.mostPrivate: Most private doesn’t change address, so phones never need this step.
away.problem.tried: tried {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}} since {time}
away.problem.noInternet: This computer can’t reach the internet, so your phones can’t reach it right now.
away.problem.downloadFailed: The extra part didn’t finish downloading, so nothing was started.
away.problem.checkFailed: The extra part didn’t pass Nocturne’s check, so it wasn’t used and nothing was started.
away.problem.helperFailed: {company} didn’t answer, so your phones can’t reach this computer right now.
away.problem.accountBlocked: Tailscale wouldn’t let this computer join your account. Try another account, or turn Away from home off.
away.problem.unsupported: Most private isn’t available on this computer yet. Simple works here.
away.problem.rest: Everything else in Nocturne works as normal.
away.problem.restPhones: Everything else in Nocturne works as normal. Anything your phones keep waits on them until this is back.
away.problem.stillPaired: Still paired. They’ll connect again by themselves once this is fixed.
away.problem.trial: Cloudflare offers Simple for free without promises, so this can happen. If it keeps happening, Most private may suit you better.
away.todo.heading: Still to come
away.todo.leaving: Leaving at any step turns Away from home back off.
away.todo.scan: Scan a code with your phone and allow it here
away.firewall: Your computer may ask whether Nocturne’s Tailscale part may accept connections. Allow it.
away.choice.legend: How should your phone reach this computer?
away.choice.simple.needs: Nothing to sign up for. Nothing to install on your phone.
away.choice.simple.sees: Your phone reaches this computer through Cloudflare, a large internet company. Nocturne locks what you ask and keep, so Cloudflare can’t read it. Cloudflare can see when your phone connects, from where, and how much, and it hands your phone the page it opens.
away.choice.mostPrivate.needs: A Tailscale account and its app on your phone.
away.choice.mostPrivate.sees: Your phone and computer talk to each other directly. Tailscale, a network company, helps them find each other. It can see that they’re connected, and when, but not what you keep or ask.
away.ask.title: Nocturne needs a small extra part from {company} (about {size}) to connect your phone. Download it now?
away.ask.body: It’s the piece that lets your phone reach this computer through {company}. Nocturne checks it before it’s used, and the download shows on the Privacy screen like every other.
away.ask.runsOnly: Only while Away from home is on
away.download.title: Getting the extra part from {company}.
away.download.body: When it’s done, Nocturne checks it and starts it by itself.
away.download.leaving: Pause to carry on later. Leaving this page turns Away from home back off.
away.signIn.title: Sign in to Tailscale in your browser.
away.signIn.body: We’ve opened Tailscale’s sign-in page. Sign in, or make a free account with Google, Microsoft, Apple or GitHub. Nocturne carries on by itself when you’re done.
away.signIn.waiting: Waiting for you to sign in…
away.signIn.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy the link. Choose Open the page again instead.
away.signIn.sees.heading: What Tailscale sees
away.signIn.sees: That this computer and your phone are connected, and when. Not what you keep or ask.
away.signIn.name: In your Tailscale account this computer shows under a made-up name, so its name says nothing about you.
away.signIn.why.heading: Why this is needed
away.links.title: Allow secure links in Tailscale.
away.links.body: Your phone needs a secure link to reach Nocturne, and Tailscale only gives one if your account allows it. We’ve opened the right page in your browser.
away.links.switch: On that page, turn on the switch Tailscale calls “Enable HTTPS”, then come back here. It’s one switch, and you only do it once.
away.links.waiting: Waiting for Tailscale… Nocturne carries on by itself.
away.links.why: Phones only trust a link to this computer once Tailscale vouches for it. It doesn’t let anyone else in.
away.links.name: The made-up name this computer uses appears in a public list of secure links. That’s why it says nothing about you.
away.phoneApp.title: Get Tailscale on your phone.
away.phoneApp.body: Install the free Tailscale app, then sign in with the same account you just used. Nocturne can only reach your phone while the app is on.
away.phoneApp.iphone.where: Search for “Tailscale” in the App Store
away.phoneApp.signedIn: This computer is signed in to Tailscale.
away.phoneApp.b: Sign in with the same account
away.phoneApp.c: Leave Tailscale switched on when you want to use Nocturne
away.add.title: Add a phone
away.add.qr: Code to scan with your phone’s camera
away.add.minutesLeft: {count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} left on this code.
away.add.point: Point your phone’s camera at this code.
away.add.step1: Open the camera on your phone and tap the link it shows.
away.add.step2: Give the phone a name you’ll recognise.

away.add.codeLabel: Code to type, in four groups of six
away.add.expired.title: This code has expired.
away.add.expired.body: Each code works once, for 5 minutes, so an old photo of one is no use to anyone. Make a new one when your phone is ready.
away.add.refused.title: That phone wasn’t added.
away.add.refused.body: You chose not to allow it, and its code is used up. Make a new code to try again.
away.add.timedOut.title: That phone wasn’t added.
away.add.timedOut.body: Nobody allowed it in time, so Nocturne refused it by itself. Make a new code to try again.
away.add.spent.title: That code was used up.
away.add.spent.body: Another attempt used the code first, so Nocturne ended it. Make a new code, and add the phone you’re holding.
away.add.added.title: {name} is added.
away.add.added.body: {name} can now ask, keep things and read today’s page when you’re out.
away.add.paused.title: Adding phones is paused.
away.add.paused.body: Someone tried several wrong codes. Adding phones starts again at {time}.
away.add.unavailable.title: Away from home isn’t ready for a new phone.
away.add.unavailable.body: It has to be on first. Go back to see how it is.
away.pair.title: A phone wants to connect
away.pair.check: . Check your phone shows the same three words.
away.pair.warning: If the words are different, or it isn’t a phone you’re holding, don’t allow it.
away.phones.title: Phones
away.phones.lead: These phones can reach Nocturne while Away from home is on.
away.phones.empty: No phones yet. Add one to use Nocturne when you’re out.
away.phones.lost.heading: Lost a phone?
away.phones.lost.body: Remove it here and it stops working at once, even in the middle of an answer. You can pair it again later.
away.phones.holds: A phone holds no copy of your memory. It shows answers and pages while they’re open. Things it kept while offline wait on the phone until they’ve been sent.
away.remove.title: Remove {name}?
away.remove.body: It stops working at once. You can pair it again later.
away.remove.kept: What it kept is already here and stays. Nothing on this computer is deleted.
away.activity.title: Recent activity
away.activity.error: Nocturne couldn’t read the activity. Nothing was changed.
away.activity.empty: Nothing yet. What your phones do is listed here.
away.activity.listed.heading: What’s listed
away.activity.listed.body: What happened and when. Never what was asked or kept.
away.activity.kept: Kept for 90 days, then let go.
away.activity.unusual.then: Adding phones was paused for 15 minutes. Nobody got in. If this happens again, turn Away from home off for a while, or switch to Most private.

advanced.away.title: Advanced details
advanced.away.dek: For the curious. Nothing here needs changing.
advanced.away.off: Away from home is off, so nothing is running.
advanced.away.newKey.title: Make a new computer key?
advanced.away.newKey.body: Every phone stops working at once and has to be added again. Do this if you think a code or this computer’s key got out.
advanced.away.helper.simple: {name} {version} · {checked} · up {uptime} · {restarts, plural, one {# restart} other {# restarts}}
advanced.away.sealing: P-256 key agreement per phone · HKDF · AES-GCM with counters · 15 minute sessions
advanced.away.middle.simple: connect times, phone address and rough place, sizes of everything sent, and it serves the phone page · sealed frames only
advanced.away.middle.mostPrivate: device list and when they connect · relayed frames are sealed
advanced.away.traffic: about {size} a day keeping the connection up · estimate
advanced.away.limits: per phone 60 requests, 10 asks, 30 keeps a minute · 50 MB an item · 500 MB a day
advanced.away.audit: {count, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} · no content · kept 90 days
advanced.away.hides.heading: What the channel does not hide
advanced.away.hides.middle: The company in the middle sees a stable id for each phone, session ids, how many frames there are and how big (JSON is padded to 256 byte steps), and when. It can delay or drop frames, or stop pairing.
advanced.away.hides.page.simple: Simple, one caveat: whoever serves the phone page can change it. If someone broke into Cloudflare, they could alter the page your phone opens and read along while it runs. Most private avoids this.
advanced.away.hides.page.mostPrivate: The phone page comes from this computer, so the company in the middle cannot change it.
advanced.away.hides.address: A typed address must be exact, because a look-alike site is caught only if the three words are compared.
advanced.away.hides.allow: Tapping Allow without comparing the three words defeats them if someone in the middle also has the code, for example from a photo of the screen.
advanced.away.hides.key: After a new computer key, or Delete everything, phones can only say they can’t connect. No sealed removal notice is possible.
advanced.away.hides.account: With Most private, other people and devices on the same Tailscale account can reach the listener and try to pair. They still need a code and your Allow.
